title: Polyeleos
content:
Praise the nameof the Lord, praise Him, servants of the Lord. Alleluia! (3x)
Who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God. Alleluia! (3x)
Lord, Your name stands forever, unforgotten from age to age. Alleluia! (3x)
From Zion may the Lord be blessed, He who dwells in Jerusalem. Alleluia! (3x)
O give thanks to the Lord for He is good, alleluia, for His love endures forever. Alleluia! (3x)
Who fixed the earth firmly on the seas, alleluia, for His love endures forever. Alleluia! (3x)
He snatched us away from our foes, alleluia, for His love endures forever. Alleluia! (3x)
To the God of heaven give thanks, alleluia, for His love endures forever. Alleluia! (3x)
